svg.text: Ports open straight into the plenums; no internal turn.
Parallel thread. Seal with a bonded washer or
O-ring face seal — NOT with PTFE tape: shredded
tape migrates into the 0.25 mm channels.
MATL: OXYGEN-FREE copper C10200 / JIS C1020.
Braze land flat 0.02, Ra 0.8, matched to CP-101.
Fin land boss 0.5 proud, flat 0.02 — it seals the fin field
Deburr port bores fully. Any chip ends up in a channel.
Do not braze the fin land. Mechanical contact only.
